verdict.rationale: E2B ships its own first-party recipe for running AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Amp in its sandboxes, with full terminal, filesystem, and git access. It also provides a pre-built `claude` template with Claude Code already installed, so the core story is directly documented. Missing for 10: a detailed Codex-specific recipe (Codex appears only in the use-case overview), and independent or hands-on corroboration of running these agents in E2B.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can run coding agents like Claude Code or Codex inside the sandbox following the vendor's own recipe

citations.quote: Run AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Amp in secure E2B sandboxes with full terminal, filesystem, and git access.
E2B provides a pre-built `claude` template with Claude Code already installed.
